headline: Kraken Maintains Bitcoin Trades Executed at $17,000 Following Canadian Dollar Glitch
summary: Cryptocurrency exchange Kraken confirmed that trades executed at $17,000 per bitcoin will stand following an order book failure on its Canadian dollar market that briefly cut prices over 70%.
why: Order book liquidity disruptions on digital asset exchanges can trigger localized market drops and require formal trade settlement determinations.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: An exchange order book anomaly triggered steep localized price discounts on CAD pairs.
